title: Scutellarin-eluting stents attenuate coronary restenosis by inhibiting the abnormal proliferation and migration of vascular smooth muscle cells through suppression of NF-kappaB signaling.
authors: Zhang, Li; Wang, Yuting; Gao, Wei Min; Gao, Wencong; Ni, Ruoyan; Cai, Jing; Yang, Renhua; Shen, Zhiqiang; He, Bo; Zhuo, Yu; Chen, Peng
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究灯盏花素洗脱支架抑制冠状动脉再狭窄，涉及NF-kB信号通路，但无蛋白质-DNA互作建模、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Coronary restenosis remains a major challenge following percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI), necessitating the development of effective stent-eluting drugs. Previous studies indicate that scutellarin protects vascular endothelial cells and exhibits anti-thrombotic and anti-platelet effects. Notably, our prior research demonstrated that scutellarin specifically counteracts oxidative stress-driven endothelial dysfunction, a key initiating event in restenosis. This combined evidence strongly suggests its potential against in-stent restenosis (ISR). Therefore, this study explores the efficacy of scutellarin in preventing ISR after PCI. PURPOSE: We investigated scutellarin, derived from Erigeron breviscapus, for its potential to prevent ISR following PCI. STUDY DESIGN: The efficacy and mechanism of scutellarin were evaluated using both in vivo and in vitro models. METHODS: An experimental atherosclerosis model was established in APOE(-/-) mice. A coronary stenosis stent model was subsequently developed in minipigs through high-fat diet and balloon induced injury. Scutellarin-eluting stents with varying doses were implanted at stenosis sites. At 28 days post-PCI, multimodal imaging (QCA, OCT, IVUS) was performed to assess anti-restenosis efficacy. Additionally, in vitro H(2)O(2)-induced vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs) were used to monitor proliferation and migration. Protein levels were measured to elucidate molecular mechanisms. RESULTS: In APOE(-/-) mice, scutellarin significantly reduced lipid deposition in aortic plaques and suppressed inflammatory responses. In the porcine model, it markedly decreased neointimal thickness, neointimal area, and restenosis rates, while inhibiting inflammation. Collectively, these two in vivo models demonstrate that scutellarin-eluting stents effectively inhibit ISR. In vitro, scutellarin suppressed VSMCs proliferation and migration and mediated a shift from necrosis to autophagy-coordinated apoptosis. Mechanistically, scutellarin-mediated suppression of the synthetic phenotype switch in VSMCs was accompanied by the coordinated downregulation of both the Pl3K/AKT and IKKs/NF-kappaB cascades. CONCLUSIONS: This study establishes the efficacy of scutellarin in mitigating ISR using two complementary in vivo models. Scutellarin-eluting stents in atherosclerotic minipigs overcome translational barriers through full interventional simulation. Furthermore, scutellarin inhibits VSMCs proliferation, migration and promotes autophagy-coordinated apoptosis by the coordinated downregulation of both the Pl3K/AKT and lKKs/NF-kappaB cascades.These findings highlight scutellarin as a promising candidate for next-generation bioactive stent coatings, bridging phytopharmacology and precision interventional cardiology.
abstract_zh: 背景：冠状动脉再狭窄仍然是经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）后的重大挑战，亟需开发有效的支架载药。既往研究表明，灯盏花素可保护血管内皮细胞，并具有抗血栓和抗血小板作用。值得注意的是，我们先前的研究证明，灯盏花素特异性对抗氧化应激驱动的内皮功能障碍，这是再狭窄的关键起始事件。综合这些证据强烈提示其在支架内再狭窄（ISR）中的潜在作用。因此，本研究探讨灯盏花素在PCI后预防ISR的疗效。目的：我们研究了源自灯盏细辛（Erigeron breviscapus）的灯盏花素在PCI后预防ISR的潜力。研究设计：通过体内和体外模型评估灯盏花素的疗效和机制。方法：在APOE(-/-)小鼠中建立实验性动脉粥样硬化模型。随后通过高脂饮食和球囊诱导损伤在小型猪中建立冠状动脉狭窄支架模型。将不同剂量的灯盏花素洗脱支架植入狭窄部位。PCI后28天，采用多模态影像学（QCA、OCT、IVUS）评估抗再狭窄疗效。此外，使用体外H(2)O(2)诱导的血管平滑肌细胞（VSMCs）监测增殖和迁移。测量蛋白水平以阐明分子机制。结果：在APOE(-/-)小鼠中，灯盏花素显著减少主动脉斑块中的脂质沉积并抑制炎症反应。在猪模型中，灯盏花素显著减少新生内膜厚度、新生内膜面积和再狭窄率，同时抑制炎症。综合这两个体内模型表明，灯盏花素洗脱支架有效抑制ISR。在体外，灯盏花素抑制VSMCs增殖和迁移，并介导从坏死向自噬协调凋亡的转变。机制上，灯盏花素介导的VSMCs合成表型转换抑制伴随着Pl3K/AKT和IKKs/NF-kappaB级联的协同下调。结论：本研究通过两个互补的体内模型确立了灯盏花素在减轻ISR中的疗效。动脉粥样硬化小型猪中的灯盏花素洗脱支架通过完整介入模拟克服了转化障碍。此外，灯盏花素通过Pl3K/AKT和lKKs/NF-kappaB级联的协同下调抑制VSMCs增殖、迁移并促进自噬协调凋亡。这些发现凸显灯盏花素作为下一代生物活性支架涂层的 promising 候选药物，桥接植物药理学和精准介入心脏病学。
